Candidates

Every extracted candidate with its statistics, method ranks and labels

3 513 candidates passed the frequency filters. 925 of them were labelled by the language models; the rest carry only the rule-based pre-label (label_source = rule), and do_llm in kategoria means the rules could not decide either. None of the labels has been checked by a human.

WarningTwo form columns

forma_kandydata is the string the statistics were computed for. forma_podstawowa is the same string unless the language model returned a different base form: this happened for 122 candidates, and for 60 of them the model’s form has a different number of words (for example a single adjective replaced by a whole two-word term), so the counts in the row do not describe the string in forma_podstawowa. Because of these replacements 144 rows share their forma_podstawowa with another row. Filter form_changed = yes to see them.

Type in the boxes under the column names to filter a single column (for example T3 under kategoria), click a header to sort, and use Columns to show the hidden rank and per-model columns.

Source file: kandydaci.csv (view · download).

NoteColumn glossary
Column Meaning
forma_podstawowa Base (dictionary) form of the candidate. Where the LLM returned a different base form, this is the LLM’s form; compare with forma_kandydata.
forma_kandydata The candidate exactly as extracted in step 4. All counts, scores and ranks in the row were computed for this string.
form_changed Derived for this page: yes if forma_podstawowa differs from forma_kandydata.
kategoria Label used for the pools: the LLM label where available, otherwise the rule-based pre-label.
label_source Derived for this page: LLM if kategoria comes from the models, rule if only from the rule-based pre-label.
pojecie Short concept label from the LLM, shared by variants and synonyms.
obrazowalnosc LLM judgement whether the concept can be shown in a picture or diagram (tak, czesciowo, nie).
dlugosc Number of words in forma_kandydata.
cls Inflectional class of the lemma from Morfeusz2 (subst noun, adj adjective, ger gerund, ppas/pact participles, fin/inf/praet verb forms, adv adverb); mwu for multiword candidates.
freq_cel Occurrences in the target corpus (biology).
freq_kontrast Occurrences in the contrast corpus (other subjects of the same school stage).
n_mat_cel Number of target materials containing the candidate.
n_przedmiotow Number of contrast subjects in which the candidate occurs (dispersion).
freq_kwjp Lemma frequency in KWJP100 (general Polish, CC BY 4.0), summed over inflectional classes.
zipf_wordfreq Zipf frequency from wordfreq (0 = not found; single words only).
n_mat_kontrast Number of contrast materials containing the candidate.
n_klas_cel Number of distinct estimated grades among target materials containing the candidate.
ll_vs_kontrast Log-likelihood keyness, target vs contrast corpus; negative when relatively rarer in biology.
log_ratio_kontrast Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs contrast (smoothing 0.5).
ll_vs_kwjp Log-likelihood keyness against KWJP100 (reference size is a convention; use for ranking only).
log_ratio_kwjp Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs KWJP100.
simple_maths_kwjp Kilgarriff’s Simple Maths keyness against KWJP100 (per-million rates, N = 1).
tfidf_biol Relative frequency in biology × log(1 + subjects / (1 + n_przedmiotow)).
rozproszenie Same value as n_przedmiotow (higher = more cross-subject, i.e. more T2-like).
pmi Pointwise mutual information of the first two lemmas of a multiword candidate (0 for single words).
logdice logDice of the first two lemmas of a multiword candidate (0 for single words).
rank_ll_vs_kontrast Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kontrast (1 = best).
rank_log_ratio_kontrast Rank of the candidate by log_ratio_kontrast (1 = best).
rank_simple_maths_kwjp Rank of the candidate by simple_maths_kwjp (1 = best).
rank_ll_vs_kwjp Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kwjp (1 = best).
rank_tfidf_biol Rank of the candidate by tfidf_biol (1 = best).
rank_pmi Rank of the candidate by pmi (1 = best).
rank_logdice Rank of the candidate by logdice (1 = best).
cvalue TermoPL C-value on the target corpus (0 = not returned by TermoPL).
rank_cvalue Rank of the candidate by cvalue (1 = best).
termopl_ok Whether TermoPL ran successfully in this run.
etykieta_regulowa Rule-based pre-label from frequency thresholds (T3?, T2?, T1?, do_llm = undecided).
kategoria_final LLM label (empty if the candidate was not sent to the LLM).
forma_podstawowa_llm Base form returned by the LLM.
do_przegladu True if the models disagreed or one had low confidence, so Opus adjudicated.
haiku_5_5_kategoria Label from Claude Haiku 5.5.
haiku_5_5_pewnosc Self-reported confidence of Claude Haiku 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).
sonnet_5_5_kategoria Label from Claude Sonnet 5.5.
sonnet_5_5_pewnosc Self-reported confidence of Claude Sonnet 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).
opus_5_5_kategoria Label from Claude Opus 5.5.
opus_5_5_pewnosc Self-reported confidence of Claude Opus 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).
